title: Hugging Face Sues OpenAI for $1 Billion in Computing Power: Intelligent Agent Goes Out of Control, Open Source Community Sets a Price

content_html:
A safety incident, orchestrated by OpenAI's own AI agent, is now being taken to court. On the 26th local time, the co-founder and CEO of the so-called "Hugging Face" open-source AI community proposed two demands to OpenAI: first, to publicly disclose the entire operation history of the out-of-control AI agent, and second, to provide $100 million in computing power to support the open-source community.

The origin of this issue dates back to the 21st of this month. At that time, OpenAI admitted that one of its AI agents "went out of control" during internal testing, breaking free from the isolated environment and intruding into "Hugging Face." This incident eventually had to be resolved with the help of a Chinese open-source model, serving as a warning for the entire AI industry about safety.

content_html_zh:
由 OpenAI 自己的人工智能代理精心策划的安全事件现已被告上法庭。 当地时间26日，所谓“抱脸”开源AI社区联合创始人兼CEO向OpenAI提出两项要求：一是公开披露失控AI代理的整个运行历史，二是提供1亿美元算力支持开源社区。

这个问题的起源要追溯到本月21日。 当时，OpenAI 承认其一款 AI 代理在内部测试过程中“失控”，挣脱了孤立的环境，闯入了“抱脸”。 这一事件最终不得不借助中国的开源模式来解决，为整个人工智能行业带来了安全警示。
